items.html: It thus follows, according to the aforementioned introductions, that in one respect this illumination which now comes from these Hassadim and Gevurot that have now come anew is greater and finer and larger than the first illumination that ZON already had, since that first one emanated them Achor be Achor [back to back] alone, whereas this new illumination returned them Panim be Panim [face to face]; therefore this new illumination will be called Panim be Panim. But in another respect this new illumination is inferior to the first illumination, since the first illumination made and emanated all their Partzufim [pl. of Partzuf], whereas this new illumination did only the enlarging of half their posteriors, as mentioned, and their turning Panim be Panim came of itself. Therefore this new illumination will be called Achor be Achor, for its benefit was only the enlarging of half the posterior, as mentioned.
